## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D Ukrainian city-building game with a 100-building catalog.

## Requirements
- Browser-based game with a 3D scene.
- Include the full catalog across traditional, modern, panel, luxury, and fantasy categories.
- Support building, demolition, camera movement, rotation, search, filtering, money, population, and happiness.

## Decisions
- Rebuilt the requested second catalog experience as a standalone `index.html`.
- Used Three.js via import maps with procedural 3D models and a responsive interface.
- Assumed a 15,000-₴ starting balance and 50% demolition refund.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`.
- Added 100 generated catalog entries.
- Added category tabs and name search.
- Added grid placement, occupied-cell detection, ghost previews, and demolition mode.
- Added building and HUD animations, WASD camera movement, orbit controls, zoom, and R/Delete controls.
- Added procedural roads, ridges, rocks, palms, ground, fog, and shadows.
- Verified the embedded JavaScript parses with `node --check`.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002.

### Active
- Visual browser verification is pending.

### Blocked
- Playwright CLI could not open Chromium because it expected `/home/runner/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1243/chrome-linux64/chrome`, while that browser installation was absent.

## Next Move
1. Install or configure the Playwright Chromium browser.
2. Open `http://localhost:3002` and capture a viewport image.
3. Inspect rendering and interactions, then fix any visual or runtime issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/index.html`: Complete game implementation.
- `/tmp/opencode/game-check.mjs`: Extracted module used for JavaScript syntax verification.

## Important Context
- The game server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- `/usr/bin/chromium`, `/usr/bin/chromium-browser`, and `/usr/bin/google-chrome` are present, but Playwright was configured to look for a separate bundled executable.
- The catalog entries and Three.js module were both confirmed as present after extraction.
